critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In _get_reminder_offsets, saving an empty list via PUT silently falls back to DEFAULT_REMINDER_OFFSETS on subsequent GET. This means admin cannot fully disable reminders; consider distinguishing 'not configured' from 'explicitly empty' (e.g., check if the settings doc exists rather than truthiness of offsets_minutes).

Non-blocking: 'IndexKeySpecsConflict' warnings on users email/username indexes at startup — harmless but noisy, indexes already exist with different partial-filter spec; consider aligning create_index parameters to existing DB indexes.
